groups.sentence: Instructors may prohibit students from sharing their materials with AI tools, as such sharing may violate intellectual property rights.
Instructors state at course start whether students may upload course materials to AI tools and which materials are off limits.
Everyone must not upload copyrighted, licensed or others' intellectual property into AI tools without the owner's permission.
Students must not upload course materials, including instructor-created lectures, slides and assignments, into AI tools without the instructor's permission.
Students consider copyright, ethics and whether they have permission before uploading others' content to AI tools.
Everyone uses only licensed or university-approved AI tools, or has permission, when uploading materials.
Uploading copyrighted, licensed or protected content to AI tools may violate copyright, licensing terms or intellectual property rights.
